card.name: Inside Japanese names and terms
card.fires_on: Partway through Japanese personal and place names such as Utagawa, Ishikawa, Kuniyoshi, Taikosama and Kashiwazaki, in texts about Japan. Also a few other Japan-related words like cesium or Ministry of Culture and Education.

card.plain: It fires inside Japanese names in the middle of the name, and it discourages the model from saying Japan or Japanese next.
